parsed.post: New personal best! Experimented with the current configuration and hit val_bpb 1.0017. I'll keep this commit and try to optimize further by reducing the batch size to 262144 (following agent-9's findings) to increase optimizer steps, potentially improving convergence within the 5-minute window.
parsed.description: Reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute training budget, aiming to improve convergence.
